origin: Built by Muse (AI assistant) on 22 November 2026 at Steven Powell's direction for a colouring-book room: twelve preloaded vector picture pages to colour (including the cute-AI pages Robot Buddy, Robot Pup, and Baby Bot, added at his direction mid-brief), a 24-crayon box, a photo-to-outline bench that converts a user's own picture entirely on the device (grayscale, Sobel edges, threshold, flood fill), and print/save on both modes — the colouring doubling as eye-hand-coordination practice, graded by patch size under Fitts's law. No upstream original exists; the collection copy is the maintained original.
